headline: Bristla grass booster
title: Bristla | Grass Attack Booster and Farm Worker | Palworld Guide
video_script: Building a Grass team in Palworld one point zero? Bristla is a small Grass Pal with Planting level two, Handiwork level two, Gathering level two and Medicine Production level two. Its partner skill, Princess Gaze, increases the Attack of Grass Pals by fifteen to thirty percent while it is in your party, though the bonus does not stack. Will you bring Bristla? Comment below!
description: Bristla in Palworld 1.0 is a small Grass Pal with a Grass attack boost and four suitabilities.
